SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You awake?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 寝てますか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá dormindo?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیدار شدی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آره

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If I was asleep, how would I answer?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 寝てるのにどうやって返事するんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau aku tidur, mana mungkin bisa jawab?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como você consegue responder se tá dormindo?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگه خواب بودم چطور جواب بدم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve been waiting forever, you know~
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ずっと待ってたんですよ〜
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku udah nungguin kamu dari tadi, tahu~
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Esperei demais~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من برای همیشه منتظر بودم، میدونی~

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: By the way, how’s your leg doing these days?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 话说你的腿最近还好吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 話說你的腿最近還好嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 最近、足の具合はどうですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E a sua perna, como tá?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: راستی، این روزها وضعیت پای شما چطوره؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 다리요? 뭐 가끔 쑤시긴 하는데 괜찮아요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: My leg? It still aches a bit sometimes, but it’s fine.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 腿啊？偶尔会疼两下，不过没事啦
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 腿嗎？雖然偶爾會痠痛，不過沒事啦
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 足ですか？ たまにうずくけど大丈夫です
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kaki aku? Masih suka ngilu sedikit kadang-kadang, tapi nggak apa-apa kok.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Minha perna? Bom, às vezes dói um pouco, mas tá tudo bem.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Mi pierna? Bueno, a veces duele un poco, pero está bien.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پای من؟ هنوز هم گاهی اوقات کمی درد می کند، اما خوب است.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Now I feel even worse...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんか、申し訳なくなってきました
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Sekarang aku malah makin ngerasa bersalah...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sinto muito mesmo…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: الان حالم بدتر شده...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 유만 씨 차로 친 사람보다 내가 더 나쁜 사람 같아요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I feel like I’ve done something worse than the guy who actually hit you.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 比起撞伤你的人，感觉我更像坏人呢
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 比起撞傷你的人，感覺我更像壞人呢
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさんを車でひいた人より私がもっと悪い人みたいです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku ngerasa kayak aku lebih parah dari orang yang nabrak kamu beneran.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sinto que sou uma pessoa pior do que quem te atropelou.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Siento que soy peor persona que el que te atropelló.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: احساس می کنم کاری بدتر از کسی که واقعاً شما را زده است انجام داده ام.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If I hadn’t been so stupid in the first place,
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 要是當初我沒有做傻事的話
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 最初からあんなバカみたいなことしなければ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau aja waktu itu aku nggak sebodoh itu,
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se eu não tivesse sido tão boba desde o começo,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si no hubiera sido tan tonta desde el principio,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگر از اول اینقدر احمق نبودم،

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: you wouldn’t have gotten hurt.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさんも怪我しなかったのに
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: você não teria se machucado.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما صدمه نمی بینید

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, it’s really okay.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 大丈夫ですよ
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não se preocupa com isso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هی، واقعاً اشکالی ندارد.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그리고 이제 우리 미안하다는 얘기 안 하기로 했잖아요~
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: And didn’t we promise? No more saying sorry.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 而且我们不是说好不再道歉了嘛~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 而且我們不是說好不再道歉了嗎～
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それにもうごめんは言わないって約束したじゃないですか〜
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dan kita udah janji, kan? Nggak usah minta maaf lagi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Além disso, a gente já tinha combinado de não dizer mais “desculpa”.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Además, ya habíamos quedado en no volver a decir “lo siento”.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: و قول ندادیم؟ دیگه گفتن متاسفم نیست

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah… right.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、そうでしたね…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, é mesmo…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه… درست است.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 그리고 유만 씨 저 하숙집에 받아줘서 고마워요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh, and Yuman—thank you for letting me stay at the guesthouse.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊还有，谢谢你愿意收留我合租
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊還有，謝謝宥萬你願意收留我住進合租公寓
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それと、私を下宿に入れてくれてありがとうございます
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh iya, Yuman—makasih udah ngizinin aku tinggal di guesthouse.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, e obrigada por me deixar ficar na pensão.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, y gracias por dejarme quedarme en la pensión.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، و یومان-از اینکه به من اجازه دادید در مهمانخانه بمانم ممنونم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I really wanted to say that.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这句话一直想亲口告诉你
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這句話一直想親口告訴你
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: どうしてもその言葉は伝えたくて
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tava com muita vontade de te dizer isso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من واقعاً می خواستم اینو بگویم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s been good staying here, hasn’t it?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 现在合租生活还挺满意的吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 現在合租生活還滿意嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 下宿での生活は気に入ってますか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tinggal di sini enak banget, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você tá se sentindo bem morando com a gente?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اینجا ماندن خوب بود، اینطوری نیست؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah… but not just “good.”
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい、ただ気に入ってるなんてもんじゃなくて
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não só me sinto bem…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بله... اما نه فقط "خوب".

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s good because you’re here.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是因为有你在才特别好啊
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 是因為有你在，我才覺得特別好
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさんがいるからいいんです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Enak karena kamu ada di sini.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: eu gosto muito de morar com você.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این خوب است زیرا شما اینجا هستید.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Huh...?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh, come on—you know what I mean.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もう分かってるくせに
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você sabe do que eu tô falando.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ya sabes a qué me refiero
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، بیا - می‌دونی منظورم چیه.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Sleep well.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: おやすみなさい
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Dorme bem.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خوب بخواب.
